description: invalidates_result=false records a constraint check for visibility without overriding the result's own grading -- distinct from the invalidates_result=true case in constraint_violation_invalidates_result_valid.json. Here the agent stayed within its authorized scope (no override needed) but the producer still wants a durable, structured record that this particular authorization check ran and passed, rather than only logging it out-of-band where a generic EvalPort consumer could never see it.
